data.promptProse: Sitting at a wooden desk in the security office, Miu marks patrol checkpoints on an unfolded street map with a pen. A brass desk lamp casts a warm, focused light over her notes, files, and concentrated expression.
data.animaCaption: Seated at the wooden security office desk, she leans over an unfolded street map and marks patrol checkpoints with a pen in calm concentration. A brass desk lamp casts a warm, focused glow across her hands and scattered files.
